summary: Iter-44 continued the TRELPNG acceptance test focused on Phases 3, 7, 9, 10 and portions of 4, 6, 11 that iter-43 left uncovered. Safety gate re-verified (DB_NAME=test_database, MONGO_URL=localhost, preview URL matches). Created a comprehensive backend integration suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter44_full_workflow.py — 32/32 assertions PASS in isolation. Coverage: PHASE 3 — submitted 4 real E2E-TEST-20260819 prefixed properties via /advertiser/drafts/current/submit (P01 house-sale, P02 house-rent, P04 vacant land, P10 near-duplicate of P04) using the pre-seeded advertiser account after completing the must-change-password flow programmatically. TREL- references were auto-generated by the pa_counters sequence. Also proved validation blockers: missing province rejected (400), missing declarations rejected (400 with 'declaration' in message), zero price rejected (400), 1990-char boundary description accepted (200), special chars é ñ & <ok> in title accepted (200), advertiser sees own submissions via GET /advertiser/submissions. PHASE 7 — exercised 6 real workflow actions via POST /property-advertising/actions: submission.confirm_new_property (→Ready), publication.publish (→Published), publication.suspend (→Suspended), lifecycle.send_confirmation (→Awaiting Advertiser, creates pa_notifications row), location_request.share_location (→Active), advertiser.verify_identity (→Active). Each action creates a pa_audit row with performed_by_id, performed_by_name, record_type, reference, previous_status, new_status, action, reason, channel, created_at. PHASE 9 — audit collection populated (34+ events); every event carries required fields; no 'password_hash' / 'password' / 'temp_password' key leaks. pa_notifications recipient_user_id / requested_by_id are opaque UUIDs (no '@' present → no email leakage in body); ALL notifications remain status='queued' (Resend NOT wired). PHASE 10 — security contract: unauth /workspace and /actions → 401; unknown reference → 404; unknown record_type → 404; unsupported action → 400; action on missing reference → 404; audit-events PUT/DELETE → 404/405 (append-only via absence of write routes); staff workspace REJECTS advertiser token → 403; /advertiser/* endpoints REJECT admin token → 403; advertiser cannot hijack draft ownership by submitting owner_user_id in payload.data (server derives owner_user_id from token, verified on returned doc); advertiser gets 403 attempting GET /submission/{staff-ref}. PHASE 6/11 (browser smoke, 1440×900) — admin@trel.com.pg login → /admin/property-advertising renders S01 KPIs and priority-work-queue with seeded rows (TREL-10428, ADV-00931, TREL-10461, LOC-0081). S02/S03/S07/S08/S09 list routes load without page-crash. S03A submissions/TREL-10428 renders. Unknown ref submissions/TREL-DOESNOTEXIST correctly triggers 404 fetch (no crash). Mobile 390×844 home page has NO horizontal scroll. Frontend production build SUCCEEDS (`yarn build` → 'Compiled successfully', 18.04s). Full backend suite ran but hit rate-limit interference across older iterations — iter-44 tests pass 32/32 in isolation.

minor.issue: TRANSITIONS map is missing several workflow actions from the acceptance spec: return_for_correction, resubmit_corrected, link_to_existing_master (only 'link_master_property' exists — name drift), reject_invalid, unpublish (missing — only publish/suspend/return/unpublish is defined but not all Phase 7f 'republish' etc), receive_request, request_more_info, arrange_inspection variants, approve_secure_sharing, mark_ACTIVE/NOT_SEEN/REMOVED/INACTIVE/withdraw/archive/relist. Many named lifecycle transitions from the spec are simply not implemented — /actions will return 400 'Action is not allowed for this record type'.

NO S02B Identity-Verification endpoint, NO S03B Conflicts endpoint, NO S03C Authority endpoint, NO S07A/S08A/S09A per-record endpoints beyond the generic /{record_type}/{reference}. NO file-upload endpoint anywhere in the module (grep confirms). NO public property endpoint for the S07 published listings — cannot test 'private docs must not leak to public' because there is no public path.

No duplicate-detection logic; P10 near-duplicate of P04 submits successfully with no conflict flagged (S03B is a static seed row, not driven by actual near-duplicate detection). Report as MISSING FEATURE.

In-memory sliding window is shared across all callers of a given email; automated testing easily saturates it and requires backend restart to clear. Not durable across restarts; not per-instance in multi-node deploy. Documented from iter-43; still applicable.

critical_code_review_comments: property_advertising.py validate_submission enforces required fields + declarations but does NOT enforce prefix, length limits on title, description, or authority evidence fields — 1990-char description accepted; consider explicit max_length in Pydantic model rather than downstream validate.

AdvertiserDraftIn accepts arbitrary dict for `data` — no schema validation on client-supplied fields. This is what lets a client sneak 'owner_user_id' into data (harmless because server derives top-level owner_user_id from token, verified in test). Consider a stricter Pydantic model per step, or a documented allow-list.
STATUS_INDEX / TRANSITIONS state machine uses fixed positional indices into `row` arrays — brittle. Any addition to the row schema silently shifts status column. Convert to keyed dict.

S01 KPI cards (24/7/11/8/5) may be static in StaffPropertyAdvertising.jsx (was not investigated line-by-line this iteration) — verify they are computed from workspace API and not hard-coded like the advertiser dashboard was.

No ETag/version header on GET /{record_type}/{reference} — the /actions endpoint already implements optimistic-concurrency via {updated_at} match (returns 409), but clients have no exposed way to fetch that timestamp cleanly; document it in API contract.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter-44 established the REAL backend surface for property-advertising: only ONE draft-submit endpoint, ONE generic /actions state-machine, ONE generic /{record_type}/{reference} detail endpoint, ONE audit-events read, ONE notification-outbox read. NO file-upload, NO duplicate-detection, NO S02B/S03B/S03C/S07A/S08A/S09A dedicated endpoints, NO advertiser return-loop endpoint beyond drafts. Therefore Phases 5 (uploads), 8 (return loop with staff notes/messages on A12), 7's conflict-resolution/authority-review/exact-location secure-share sub-actions, and most of Phase 6's staff sub-tabs (T1-T4 with real evidence data) CANNOT be executed until the developer implements those endpoints — they are FEATURE GAPS, not test misses. Iter-44 remaining scope that is STILL testable but was not exhaustively covered this iteration: (a) full A01-A12 browser walkthrough with draft-save-logout-login-resume-submit for all 10 properties (only 4 were submitted via API, not through the UI); (b) filter/search/sort/pagination on S02/S03/S07/S08/S09; (c) responsive testing at 1024/768 (only 1440 desktop + 390 mobile done here); (d) advertiser message/inbox on A12 (backend endpoint TBD); (e) 429 rate-limit boundary tests (skipped to avoid disrupting suite). Full-suite pytest (all iterations) is noisy — 278 pass / 10 fail / 67 error — but the failures/errors are pre-existing across iter29/33/34/36/37/41 tests, unrelated to property-advertising and unrelated to this review. iter-44 tests pass 32/32 in isolation.
rca_of_the_issue: No new blocking defect introduced. Root cause of missing feature coverage: /app/backend/routes/property_advertising.py implements a MINIMAL state-machine + static SEED data + single generic mutation endpoint (/actions) — many acceptance-spec workflow actions and screens (S02B/S03B/S03C, file uploads, duplicate detection, secure-sharing gate, publication access-control for private docs) simply do not exist yet. The static seed rows populate the S-series tables so UI renders, but the underlying business logic is stubbed. Reproduction: grep TRANSITIONS in property_advertising.py — the set of allowed actions is far smaller than the acceptance spec Phase 7 list. grep 'upload' or 'file' across /app/backend/routes/property_advertising.py — no matches. grep AdvertiserWorkspace.jsx DEFAULT_DRAFT — 'photos: 7, documents: 3' are numeric literals.
